name: heddy-ip
description: Generate on-model images, stickers, and reels of Heddy — the aitutors.me snowy-owl mascot — with identity governance: locked character DNA, frozen reference sheets, templated prompts, and a QA gate with a repair policy.

interface.shortDescription: On-model brand art of the aitutors.me snowy owl
interface.longDescription: One snowy-owl character, identity governed. Generates editorial scenes, explainer diagrams, transparent cutout stickers, expression and pose sheets, and narrated reels — while keeping the same character identity in every asset. Ships the character DNA, the frozen crayon-storybook reference set, prompt templates, a QA checklist with repair policy, and a stdlib-only Gemini generation CLI (needs GEMINI_API_KEY).
defaultPrompt: heddy-ip: shot list for this blog post — 4 illustrations
heddy-ip: make a transparent cutout of the owl waving, 1:1
heddy-ip: a 1:1 feed image — Heddy presenting a flashcard
